title: Sentimental Graffiti: First Window
native_title: センチメンタル・グラフティ ～ファースト・ウィンドウ～
overview:
Please open it.

A slightly bittersweet first window.

Sentimental Graffiti First Window is a collector's multimedia disc that previews the romance game Sentimental Graffiti and introduces its twelve heroines. It holds a digital art gallery of about 80 illustrations by Tomohisa Kai shown in high resolution, a digital art book of black-and-white character design sheets for all twelve girls, profile cards for each heroine, a documentary movie of the voice actress audition, and video messages to the fans from the twelve voice actresses.

- Digital illustration gallery and character design collection
- Audition documentary and voice actress message movies
- Single player
